Name: common-prefix
Summary: Returns the longest prefix shared by all accumulated strings.
Behavior: Empty input returns null. A single string is returned unchanged. Nonempty input with no shared text, including an empty string, returns empty text. Comparison is ordinal and case-sensitive, without Unicode normalization. The result is independent of input order. Null and non-string elements throw InvalidCastException, even after the running result becomes empty.

Name: common-suffix
Summary: Returns the longest suffix shared by all accumulated strings.
Behavior: Empty input returns null. A single string is returned unchanged. Nonempty input with no shared text, including an empty string, returns empty text. Comparison is ordinal and case-sensitive, without Unicode normalization. The result is independent of input order. Null and non-string elements throw InvalidCastException, even after the running result becomes empty.

Name: any
Summary: Returns `true` when at least one accumulated boolean value is `true`.

Name: closest
Summary: Returns the first non-null input value with the smallest absolute distance to the target.
Behavior: The result preserves the selected input value and its type. Numeric targets use subtract; other targets use duration-between. Compatibility and coercion follow those operations. Values whose distance is null are ignored. Ties preserve input order. A null target, empty input, or input without a valid distance returns null. Arithmetic overflow follows the underlying difference operation.

Parameters.Name: target
Parameters.Summary: Specifies the reference value used to measure numeric or temporal distance.

Name: count
Summary: Counts the number of accumulated items, including `null` values.

Name: every
Summary: Returns `true` only when every accumulated boolean value is `true`.

Name: first
Summary: Stores the first accumulated item and ignores all subsequent items.

Name: last
Summary: Stores the most recently accumulated item.

Name: implode
Summary: Combines accumulated text values in source order, inserting the separator only between values.
Behavior: The separator defaults to the empty string. Empty input returns empty text. Empty values still participate in separator placement, and accumulating `null` is invalid.

Parameters.Name: separator
Parameters.Summary: Specifies the text inserted between consecutive accumulated values.

Name: max
Summary: Tracks the greatest numeric value found during accumulation.

Name: min
Summary: Tracks the smallest numeric value found during accumulation.

Name: reduce
Summary: Combines array elements in source order by repeatedly evaluating an expression against the accumulated value and current element.
Behavior: The combining expression receives a two-element tuple: `$0` is the accumulated value and `$1` is the current element. Without `initial`, the first element becomes the accumulated value and an empty array returns `null`. With `initial`, evaluation starts by combining it with the first element, and an empty array returns the initial value unchanged.

Parameters.Name: operation
Parameters.Summary: Specifies the expression evaluated against each accumulated-value/current-element tuple.

Parameters.Name: initial
Parameters.Summary: Specifies the initial accumulated value and the result returned for an empty array.

Name: sum
Summary: Computes the sum of all accumulated numeric values.
